discrepancies: No claim contradicted; every cited figure and date is as printed (DD-120 384.15 -> 398.50 from 2025-07-01; HC-601 December 2025 736.40 carried forward by S1 1.2; S2 April 2026 406.00; A3 416.00 effective 2026-02-01, issued 2026-08-17). Ambiguities the text leaves open (not resolved here): (1) 416.00 over 406.00 for April 2026 rests on reading 'the later' in the closing sentence of each instrument (and 'in the order issued', p37) as the later-ISSUED instrument (A3); the text can also be read against it: S2 is later-EFFECTIVE (2026-04-01 vs 2026-02-01), A3 3.1 substitutes 'for the rates in Schedule 1' while S2 2.1 is a monthly re-publication, and A3's 'Rate previously chargeable' is 398.50 (the S1 rate), not an S2 monthly rate. On the issue-order reading A3's 416.00 would also displace every later S2 monthly DD-120 figure (May-Dec 2026), which the statement does not address. (2) The 416.00 and 406.00 figures are rates before the S2 2.2 4 per cent discount on DD-120 (applied to the rate from 1 April 2026), so neither is the charged rate for April 2026. (3) A3 says the adjustment goes on the first invoice submitted 'after' the date of issue; 36A says 'on or after' - they differ for an invoice submitted on 2026-08-17 itself. (4) The SoV preamble says 'nothing in an instrument reopens a service already charged at the rate then chargeable', while A3/36A require re-pricing via a single adjustment. 'D2', 'DDS-R21' and 'Q1' are not contract references and were not checked.

discrepancies: No claim contradicted. Ambiguity (not resolved): Cl.22 says 'on any day' and does not itself say the limit is counted per well; 'per well-day' rests on D6 (not a contract reference, not checked) read with Cl.32 (each well invoiced separately) and Cl.29 ('the same well and the same day'). discrepancies: No claim contradicted. Arithmetic checked: 412 h -> 16 complete 25-hour blocks = 16% (matches App F p34); 24 h -> 0%; 25 h -> 1%; 1,250 h -> 50 blocks = 50%, equal to the cap. Sch 2D (p19) and Sch 6 (p25) cover LH-711..LH-714. Notes: App F is headed 'Illustrative only (Clause 16)'. The case 'month-of-loss FX at a half cent' cannot be reproduced from printed figures: no Sch 2D SAR value divided by any printed monthly rate (halalas per USD) gives an exact half cent, so that case must use a constructed value; the half-to-even rounding it tests is printed in 31A.

quotes.text: 41. Disputed charges The Company may withhold a disputed charge and shall pay the undisputed balance.
12. **The outcome is written down** -- pass, query, or part-reject -- with the clause relied on, the figure you say is payable, and anything you could not determine.
3. **Say when you do not know.** An invoice you cannot price is a query. Record what is missing rather than guessing a figure.
Apply the twelve checks in `INVOICE_AUDIT_GUIDELINES.md` to every invoice under both contracts, and record the outcome for each one in a **single submission file**.
Rows you cannot price are still rows — flag them if you believe they are wrong, give your confidence honestly, and say in your report what you could not determine.

discrepancies: No claim contradicted. Title matches guideline check 12 almost word for word; 'guideline principle 3' is the third of the three numbered principles above 'The checks' ('Say when you do not know'). Notes, not resolved: the README submission columns (flagged 0/1, error_category, expected_total_cents, billed_total_cents, confidence) have no pass/query/part-reject field and no field for the clause relied on; the README puts what could not be determined in the report, and for unpriceable rows says 'flag them if you believe they are wrong' rather than treating them as queries. Cl.41 says only that the Company may withhold a disputed charge and shall pay the undisputed balance; 'still valued' is a reading of 'shall pay the undisputed balance'. 'Q9' is not a contract or document reference and was not checked.
